title: Intake and staleness check
summary: Pull the ticket from Linear and GitHub and decide whether it is still live.
exit: Linked to its Linear issue and GitHub issue or PR
Last update date and current status recorded
Duplicates and superseding work checked
Roadmap card linked or marked none

title: Discovery and gap analysis
summary: Compare what the ticket asks for with what already exists in the app.
exit: Existing code and recent commits reviewed
Feature-by-feature gap list written
Recommendation: build, close as superseded, or split
Remaining effort estimated

title: Design
summary: Decide how it should look and behave, in the existing design language.
exit: Figma frame or mockup linked
Empty, loading, error and long-content states covered
Keyboard and screen-reader behaviour described
Light, dark and narrow widths considered

title: Spec and acceptance criteria
summary: Write what done means so the work can be handed to a person or an agent.
exit: Acceptance criteria written as checkable statements
Owning repo confirmed (Canvas, SDK, extensions or automation)
Issue labelled ready-for-dev
Task brief names exact file paths

title: Build in isolation
summary: One branch and worktree per ticket, with tests written first.
exit: Own branch and worktree, pushed to a remote
Tests cover the behaviour, not the markup
Translations added for every locale
No secrets or local config committed

title: Evidence and review
summary: Show the change working, then get a human to review it.
exit: Before and after screenshots or video attached
PR has every required section
HUMAN section written by a person, not an agent
Reviewer assigned

title: Verify and QA
summary: Drive the real app like a user and check it against the ticket.
exit: Checked in the real app, not only in tests
Acceptance criteria ticked one by one
Regressions checked on neighbouring screens
Findings fed back to the ticket

title: Release and monitor
summary: Ship it, then watch for drift between design and code.
exit: Merged and in the release notes
Minimum Agent Server version raised if needed
Linear issue closed with a link to the PR
Follow-up tickets filed for anything deferred
